features.F0: Existing deterministic 15-column encoding of 13 raw inputs
features.F1: F0 plus u=DNI*cos(alt)*sin(az), v=DNI*cos(alt)*cos(az), X*u, X*v, Y*u, Y*v; angles converted to radians; 21 columns
features.interpretation: Empirical interactions, not verified physical incidence. No north rotation, label-derived geometry or Room_ID features.

selection.inner: GroupKFold(3) over outer-fitting Room_IDs; unweighted validation-room original-unit MAE
selection.tie: Minimum mean MAE, then larger lambda on an exact tie
selection.preprocessing: Spline knots and StandardScaler fit independently inside each fitting split; preprocessing can be shared across targets/lambdas in the same split
selection.P10: Paired mean_log and ratio use the same chosen lambda for P10; do not replace with separately selected mean-output lambda

outer: Three LeaveOneOrientationOut groups; posX reuses identical BM223 room fold
bounds_diagnostics: Store unbounded native output and component-clipping fraction. For relative P10 raw=ratio*exp(mean_log); primary clips both components independently as before.
promotion_order: Among passing candidates: lowest primary worst-room MAE, then primary mean-room MAE, then method order T1/S0/S1/S1_direct. Otherwise retain T0.
reuse: Nine unique outer fits; reuse posX split and identical spline mean primitives within a split. Refit T0 for a clean matched baseline and verify against archived exact-parameter room OOF.
scope: Approved development experiment after observed-holdout diagnosis. No TEST numeric loading, fitting, prediction, tuning or selection in this run; no simulations or visualizations. F300/PV and trial 0.1 stay unchanged. Save fold models and decisions; no automatic full-seven deployment refit.
stopping_rule: Only the declared cells and two lambdas. Report failures without expanding the grid. No row-wise split or test-informed post-hoc routing.
